description: This file defines the interface IStateObserver for observing application state changes within the Rialto server manager service. It declares a pure virtual method 'stateChanged' that must be implemented by clients to handle state change notifications.

classes.name: IStateObserver
classes.description: An interface for subscribing to application state change notifications, to be implemented by clients.

methods.name: stateChanged
methods.description: A callback method to notify clients of application state changes, taking application ID and new session server state as parameters.
